==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|
* Speak to [[Marcellus]] at the [[Locus Oasis]].
* Speak to the blue frogs on the north-east side of the pond.
* Speak to Marcellus.
* Speak to [[Gary]] or [[Sue]] (the blue frogs) again to select a leader.
* Go south to speak to [[Jane]] or [[Dave]], the yellow frogs. Distract them by chopping down the [[Orange tree (Locus Oasis)|Orange tree]] near them. An axe spawn can be found next to Marcellus.
* While they are distracted, sabotage the lily pad in the pond near them.
* Speak to Gary or Sue to start the election.
* Speak to Marcellus.
* Speak to Gary or Sue to blame the flies.
* Go into Marcellus' house and open the chest. The combination is 'NALIA'.
* Go east to plant the [[plushy]] into the [[Capybara Dung]].
* Defeat [[Cuthbert]] (1 hp). For non-combat accounts, Cuthbert can be killed with recoil damage.
* Speak to Marcellus.
* Speak to Gary or Sue for the final time.
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
